items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: Huh? Yeah, I knew him, but I was quite young.

ctx.x: Did you have Buddy Bolin in your shop?

Huh? Yeah, I knew him, but I was quite young. See, my mother used to have a rooming house on Howard between Clio and the Rider at 1211 Howard Street. Back at that time, they didn't have no jukebox or nothing like that around in the city. They only had those electric pianos. You'd drop a nickel in them. And then they had those pianos that, it was an anna player, you're pumping with your feet. But whenever a guy come in and could play with his fingers, everybody liked that best. And they had those kind of pianos…
What do you remember about Buddy Bolin? Huh?
